note: AXI GPIO 0x41200000: ch1 = ratio_q16 (18 bit), ch2 = DSP_RUN scratch. Values below are the ones actually exercised on the board on 2026-10-25; the 0x00 register is the only one with a verified power-on reset value (C_DOUT_DEFAULT = 0x15348 = 86856).

regs.name: ratio_q16
regs.doc: pitch ratio in Q16. 65536 = bypass (output SHA must equal input SHA), 86856 = 1.3253x measured recipe, 131072 = 2x.

regs.name: dsp_run
regs.doc: ch2 is a writable scratch bit in this build; it is NOT wired to the core aresetn (see fpga/report/build_changes_2018_3.md). Do not treat it as a reset.
